cmd: cd /app/service && timeout 300 mvn -q dependency:tree 2>&1 | grep -iE "slf4j|logback|log4j|conflict" | head -60
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn dependency:tree 2>&1 | grep -iE "slf4j|logback|log4j|conflict" | head -80
cd /app/service && timeout 600 mvn dependency:tree > /tmp/tree.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -20 /tmp/tree.txt
which mvn java; java -version 2>&1; mvn -version 2>&1 | head -3
ls /opt 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/share/maven 2>/dev/null; find / -maxdepth 4 -name "mvn" -type f 2>/dev/null | head; ls ~/.m2 2>/dev/null
find / -name "mvn" 2>/dev/null | head; ls /root 2>/dev/null; ls /app; cat /etc/os-release | head -3
timeout 60 apt-get install -y maven 2>&1 | tail -5 || timeout 60 curl -sI https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/ | head -3
timeout 30 curl -sI https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.6/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.tar.gz | head -5; echo ---; timeout 30 apt-get update 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /opt && timeout 300 curl -sO https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.6/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.tar.gz && tar xzf apache-maven-3.9.6-bin.tar.gz && ln -sf /opt/apache-maven-3.9.6/bi
cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn -B dependency:tree > /tmp/tree.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -iE "slf4j|logback|log4j|conflict" /tmp/tree.txt | head -60
grep -n "logging-service:jar" /tmp/tree.txt | head -3; awk '/com.example:logging-service:jar/,/^\[INFO\] \+-- /' /tmp/tree.txt | head -5; grep -E "^\[INFO\] [\\\\+|]" /tmp/tree.txt | head -100
cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn -B clean compile > /tmp/compile.txt 2>&1; echo "compile exit=$?"; grep -E "BUILD|ERROR" /tmp/compile.txt | head -5

cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn -B dependency:tree -Dverbose > /tmp/tree2.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -iE "slf4j|logback|log4j" /tmp/tree2.txt | grep -v Download | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | he
cd /app/service && timeout 900 mvn -B test > /tmp/test.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "Tests run|BUILD|ERROR|NoSuchMethod" /tmp/test.txt | head -10
